description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Halls and rooms in a country that meet a size: optional city, minimum area (m²), minimum clear height (m) and a minimum capacity of one kind (theatre, classroom, banquet, cocktail, booths_3x3). Best fit first (the smallest published area that meets the filters), 20 per page with `next_cursor`. Each row has the venue, the fit reasons, `waste_pct`, `source_url`, `as_of` and `stale`. Spaces that do not publish a filtered figure are left out.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor` (only valid with the same arguments).

min_area_sqm.description: Minimum floor area in square metres.

name: search_venue_spaces
title: Find halls that fit
